resources.string: Cryptomator Free protects your files using the Cryptomator vault format.\n\nLocal storage, WebDAV and S3 are available with permanent read/write access. No trial, subscription or license key is required.

Cryptomator Free 0.1.0 is an unofficial fork of Cryptomator Android 2.2.0-SNAPSHOT (commit 4ebaeb9a, 2026-11-05), with permanent read/write access. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Cryptomator or Skymatic. This is a preview release.
